recognize_zh: 中央一顆體積遠大於周圍造血細胞的細胞，細胞核呈多葉狀、彼此相連，細胞質大量且充滿細小紫紅色顆粒，這是成熟（產生血小板期）巨核細胞；周圍有各階段骨髓與紅血球系前驅細胞，屬正常骨髓抹片。
features: Very large cell, many times the diameter of surrounding precursors
Single multilobulated, interconnected nucleus with coarse chromatin and no nucleoli (not multinucleated)
Abundant pale lilac cytoplasm densely filled with fine azurophilic granules, indicating a granular/platelet-producing megakaryocyte
Background of maturing granulocytic precursors (myelocytes, band and segmented neutrophils) and erythroid precursors with dark round nuclei
No dysplastic features such as separated nuclear lobes or micro-megakaryocytic forms
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular particle-adjacent field with trilineage hematopoiesis, including maturing granulocytic and erythroid precursors. A mature megakaryocyte is present, markedly larger than surrounding cells, with a single lobulated interconnected nucleus and abundant finely granular cytoplasm. No dysplastic megakaryocytic features, such as hypolobated or widely separated nuclei, are seen. Findings are consistent with a normal mature megakaryocyte.

ddx.vs: Osteoclasts contain multiple separate, uniform round nuclei with nucleoli, rather than a single lobulated nucleus.
Dysplastic forms are small hypolobated micromegakaryocytes or have multiple widely separated nuclei, unlike this normally lobulated cell.

ddx.dx: Metastatic tumor cell or giant cell
ddx.vs: Tumor cells occur in cohesive clusters with nucleoli and lack the finely granular platelet-type cytoplasm.
ET megakaryocytes are hyperlobulated staghorn giant forms in clusters, a judgment requiring biopsy architecture and counts rather than a single cell.
